main_text.p: Theologia dici potest hieratica.appellare poteris hieraticam.Nam Theologia {χ} ειολέκτως[?] accepta,est practica, tractans de bono spi-ritali: Theosophia theoretica,tractans de Deo,& rebus divinis. Kecker.de modo discendi: & in ap-paratu practico.c.de adornandis L.C. Theol.
III. Hieratica est theoretica, vel practica: illam Theosophiam, hanc Theologiam vocare nobis liceat.

IV. Theoretica est sapientia, eaq; vel na-turalis, vel supernaturalis. Quid audio,sic videor mihi objicientem quendam audire,num Theologia est habitus mixtus supernaturalis,ut ante dictu,& etiam naturalis, ut hic dicitur? Est omnino. Dicitur autem supernaturalis, quia à potiori fit denominatio. Theolo-gia etiam dicitur supernaturalis ab objecto & fine su-pernaturali, non tantùm à modo tradendi.
V. Theologia naturalis est, quæ informat hominem de reb. divinis, quatenus est homo.Theologia naturalis.
VI. Supernaturalis est, quæ informat homi-nem, quatenus est Christianus; isq; vel νεό-φυτ[?], vel adultus.
VII. Christianum νεόφυτον informat Ca-techesis, sive Theologia Catechetica.Theologia Catecheti-ca.
VIII. Christianum jam adultum informat Theologia Didactico-polemica, per locos communes.Theologia Didactico-polemica.
IX. Theologia practica est prudentia religiosa: eaq; vel communis, vel propria.
X. Communis est, quæ informat Christianos in communi, quatenus sunt membra Ecclesiæ. A Keckermanno vocatur Sotirologia, rectius Soterologia: à Calsmanno, Schola tentationumSoterologia.

page.notes: The reference mark after "Theologia" on the first line is a Greek-looking sign that I could not read with certainty; its note, if any, is not visible in this part. The Greek word "ειολέκτως" is doubtful. "Quid" in the last paragraph appears underlined in the scan. The final line of the page continues beyond this part. The Greek in VI after "νεό-" is hard to read; the final letters are uncertain. The Greek word in VII is italic. The word "tentationum" at the line end is partly worn. The first paragraph is a fragment that continues from the previous page.
